annotations.title: Price a shopping list or receipt

description:
Price a whole shopping list, or every line of a grocery receipt (up to 100 lines in one call), at Aldi, Tesco, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores and Lidl: each item matched to the same product at every store, the cheapest store for each item, each store's basket total, and a cheaper product of the same kind (often own-label) where one exists.

Each line takes name (plain words with brand and size, e.g. "avonmore fresh milk 2l"; receipt abbreviations such as "AVNMR FRSH MLK 2L" match poorly) and optionally sku (the retailer's item number as printed on its receipts; the name is used when the number is not found), barcode, store, quantity, and paid (the line total, which gives the saving against what was paid). Irish product names say "low fat milk" for what the UK calls "semi skimmed". Bags, deposits, discounts and totals are not products.

Returns, per line, the match and matched_by (sku, barcode or name), the cheapest store and price, a cheaper alternative with its pack size and, for a receipt, price_at_store_bought; then each store's total with its items_missing, cheapest_complete_store, mix_and_match_total and not_found. A store's total covers only the lines found in its online range, so a total with items_missing is a smaller basket, not a cheaper shop. Prices are each retailer's online shelf price from the overnight collection; in-store prices can differ. Member prices (Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards, Lidl Plus) are reported separately. Each matched item costs one credit; items not found are free.

count.description: How many items in the pack, when not in name, e.g. 12 for a dozen eggs, 6 for a six pack. Not how many packs were bought: that is quantity

name.description: Brand, product and size in plain words, e.g. 'avonmore fresh milk 2l', '12 eggs', 'dozen eggs'

paid.description: The line total printed on the receipt, in euro

size.description: The pack size wanted, when not in name, e.g. '2L', '500g': chooses that size at each store

sku.description: The retailer's own item number printed on the receipt line, when there is one

store.description: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl; defaults to the basket's store

items.description: The lines, up to 100, e.g. [{'name': 'avonmore fresh milk 2l', 'quantity': 2}, {'name': 'brennans wholemeal bread'}]; for a receipt add sku and paid: {'sku': '100685955', 'name': 'dunnes baked beans', 'quantity': 2, 'paid': 1.30}.

store.description: The shop the receipt is from (aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl), used for any line that names none. Leave it out for a shopping list.

name: price_basket

price_per_kg.description: unit_price worked out per kilo, where the shop prices the product by weight: the figure to compare packs of different sizes on (per kilo drained, where unit_basis says drained weight)
price_per_kg.title: Price Per Kg

price_per_litre.description: unit_price worked out per litre, where the shop prices the product by volume
price_per_litre.title: Price Per Litre

unit_basis.description: The measure unit_price is in, as the shop states it: '1 KG', '100g', '75cl', 'each'
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

unit_price.description: The shop's own unit price, in the measure unit_basis names: per kg at one shop, per 100g or per 75cl at another, so as it stands it does not compare across rows
unit_price.title: Unit Price

asked.description: The size or count the line asked for, read from its name or its size and count: {'size': '2 L'}, {'count': 12}, {'count': 6, 'each': '330 ml'}
asked.title: Asked

cheapest_alternative.description: A cheaper product of the same kind, often own-label, where there is one

pack_differs.description: True when this was priced at another pack size or count than the one the line asked for: not like for like, in the line or in a total
pack_differs.title: Pack Differs

saving_vs_paid.description: What was paid minus the cheapest price for the same quantity
saving_vs_paid.title: Saving Vs Paid

searched_as.description: The words that found the match
searched_as.title: Searched As

prices.description: Keyed by store; a store missing here did not have this product in its online range today (it may still sell it in store)
prices.title: Prices

clubcard_price.description: Member price where one applies: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_price.title: Clubcard Price

name.description: The product as this store lists it
name.title: Name

offer_ends.description: Last day the offer applies, YYYY-MM-DD, Irish time, where the retailer states it
offer_ends.title: Offer Ends

price_per_kg.description: unit_price worked out per kilo, where the shop prices the product by weight: the figure to compare packs of different sizes on (per kilo drained, where unit_basis says drained weight)
price_per_kg.title: Price Per Kg

price_per_litre.description: unit_price worked out per litre, where the shop prices the product by volume
price_per_litre.title: Price Per Litre

unit_basis.description: The measure unit_price is in, as the shop states it: '1 KG', '100g', '75cl', 'each'
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

unit_price.description: The shop's own unit price, in the measure unit_basis names: per kg at one shop, per 100g or per 75cl at another, so as it stands it does not compare across rows
unit_price.title: Unit Price

left.description: Credits left on the account after it
left.title: Left

note.description: Said when the balance is low, or when it cut this answer short
note.title: Note

used.description: Credits this answer cost: one for each record it returned
used.title: Used

items_missing.description: Matched items not found in this store's online range today (it may still sell them in store)
items_missing.title: Items Missing

cheapest_complete_store.description: The cheapest store among those with every matched item found in its online range today
cheapest_complete_store.title: Cheapest Complete Store

credits.description: What this answer cost the person's BasketWatch account and what is left. Missing on a free answer

different_pack.description: Items priced at another pack size than the one asked for, so not like for like
different_pack.title: Different Pack

lidl_plus_total.description: Lidl total using Lidl Plus prices where Lidl has one
lidl_plus_total.title: Lidl Plus Total

mix_and_match_total.description: Each item bought at its cheapest store
mix_and_match_total.title: Mix And Match Total

supervalu_real_rewards_total.description: SuperValu total using Real Rewards prices where SuperValu has one
supervalu_real_rewards_total.title: Supervalu Real Rewards Total

tesco_clubcard_total.description: Tesco total using Clubcard prices where Tesco has one
tesco_clubcard_total.title: Tesco Clubcard Total

with_alternatives_total.description: As mix_and_match_total, taking each cheaper alternative where there is one
with_alternatives_total.title: With Alternatives Total
